name: Inferno Blades
description:
Your weapons are wrapped in burning flames.

Weapons affected by this spell deal +1 Damage and are considered Magical.

If a weapon affected by this spell deals Damage, the target is set on fire. They suffer 1 Damage at the start of their turn, which ignores Armor.

The target remains on fire until they or another creature use an Action to extinguish the flames.
